best_hook.why: Wailing mother screams 'They called her a witch!' - instant shock line that tells a stranger an innocent woman has been condemned

best_cliffhanger.why: Scarred man vows '...their dead Duke is coming home' before the wedding - revenge declared, nothing yet done

must_promos.why: Rapid-fire escalation witch -> cell -> condemned -> executed -> after the wedding -> in two days, ending on 'and killing my wife afterward' with the husband's rage just ignited
Opens on the deadline threat 'marrying in two days... and killing my wife', builds through 'they stole my home' and the fist clench, cuts on the dead-Duke-returns vow and sting

standalone_risk: No villain or wife on screen; a stranger hears the names Rupert, Catherine and Juliana without faces, and the 'dead Duke' line only lands if the clip keeps that he was declared dead and his title stolen
notes: All dialogue in one cabin, no physical confrontation; strength comes from the stacked reveals and the vow.
